children.text: At the beginning of the episode, Angel stays with Buffy while recovering from injuries sustained in a battle in which he attempted to save her. Their increased proximity places them in unfamiliar territory, as they are spending more time together than they normally would. This shift in their dynamic begins to test the boundaries of their relationship, creating opportunities for their attraction to develop as the emotional distance between them becomes increasingly difficult to maintain.

Angel admits that, despite his efforts to maintain distance from Buffy, he cannot stop thinking about kissing her. His confession reveals the growing tension between his desire to be close to her and his attempts to resist that attraction. By openly acknowledging what he wants, Angel allows his feelings to surface, creating an intimate moment that marks a shift in their interaction.
